name: ezai-marketplace
description: Curated marketplace of AI skills for senior developers (Python / JS/TS)

plugins.name: ezai-cicd-expert
plugins.description: CI/CD expert for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI: write, audit, and debug pipelines; caching, matrix builds, OIDC publishing, reusable workflows, and deployment gates for Python and JS/TS projects.

capabilities.description: Generate a complete .github/workflows/*.yml from detected toolchain
Generate a complete .gitlab-ci.yml from detected toolchain
Audit an existing pipeline: security → correctness → speed → style
Diagnose a failing job from logs; request debug logs if needed
Python jobs: uv/poetry/pdm, ruff/mypy/ty, pytest, OIDC PyPI trusted publishing
JS/TS jobs: pnpm/npm/yarn, eslint/tsc/vitest, OIDC npm provenance publishing
Release patterns: auto-tag → publish → docs, reusable workflows, parent-child pipelines

plugins.name: ezai-code-formatter
plugins.description: Apply source file visual structure to match project conventions: section header comments, import ordering, spacing, and formatting — without touching logic.

capabilities.description: Add or replace main # /// and sub # --- section markers
stdlib → third-party → local, alphabetical within groups
Reorder class members: constructor → public → private
Remove redundant inline comments, preserve rationale
Google (Python) / JSDoc (JS/TS) canonical docstring style
Auto-detect language from extension, route to style file

plugins.name: ezai-docs-specialist-persona
plugins.description: Audit and upgrade an entire documentation site through a 5-stage multi-subagent pipeline: detection, audit, planning (with human gate), generation (via ezai-docs-writer), and validation.

capabilities.description: Full site audit: structure gaps vs Diátaxis quadrants, coherence findings
Prioritized fix plan with severity levels and human gate
Apply plan via ezai-docs-writer with bounded validation loop

plugins.name: ezai-docs-writer
plugins.description: Write a single documentation artifact for a software project: one .md page (any Diátaxis type), a README, docstrings, or a badge block. For whole-site audits and upgrades, use ezai-docs-specialist-persona.

capabilities.description: Badge block (README + docs/index.md)
Full README.md generation or audit
Docstrings → reference page
Tutorial page (Diátaxis)
How-To guide (Diátaxis)
Explanation page (Diátaxis)
Examples page (minimal runnable snippets)

plugins.name: ezai-project-architect
plugins.description: Architecture and design standards for Python and JS/TS projects: module structure, public API surface, design patterns (Repository, Factory, Composition), Hexagonal architecture, and type system contracts.

capabilities.description: Organize or refactor a project into feature-based modules
Define what is public vs internal in a module
Abstract all data access behind a repository interface
Apply Ports & Adapters for projects with multiple external boundaries
Encapsulate primitives with strong domain semantics
Evaluate Hexagonal vs Simple Layered before choosing an architecture
Protocols (Python), interfaces (TS), branded types
Apply Factory and Composition patterns with full code output

plugins.name: ezai-project-config
plugins.description: Toolchain setup, project configuration, and infrastructure standards for Python and JS/TS projects: pyproject.toml, package.json, linters, Docker, lockfiles, env vars, and observability.

capabilities.description: Initialize or audit a Python project's pyproject.toml
Initialize or audit a JS/TS project's package.json
Configure ruff, ty (Python) or ESLint, tsc (JS/TS)
Write a production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile for Python or Node.js
Set up uv.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, and deterministic CI installs
Configure .env, vault patterns, and secure secret handling
Add OpenTelemetry structured logs and traces
Set up uv (Python) or pnpm workspaces (JS/TS)
Configure pre-commit hooks with lint-staged or husky

plugins.name: ezai-project-performance
plugins.description: Concurrency, async patterns, and performance optimization for Python and JS/TS projects: async/await, threading vs multiprocessing, profiling, streaming, and cancellation patterns.

capabilities.description: Choose between async/await, threading, and multiprocessing for I/O vs CPU-bound work
Profile before optimizing — identify bottlenecks first
Handle multi-GB files with generators or async iterables to prevent OOM
Implement timeouts, cancellable requests, and proper async cleanup
Tree-shaking, lazy loading, and bundler optimization for JS/TS
__slots__, lru_cache, NumPy, uvloop for Python performance
Limit concurrent operations with semaphores to prevent resource exhaustion

plugins.name: ezai-project-quality
plugins.description: Testing, security, and input validation for Python and JS/TS projects: write tests, secure endpoints, validate schemas, manage secrets, and harden production code.

capabilities.description: Unit tests, parametrized cases, property-based invariants (pytest / Vitest)
Schema validation at I/O boundaries (Pydantic / Zod)
Endpoint hardening, SQL injection, XSS, auth patterns
Secret management for dev and production environments
Structured logging with correlation IDs
Quality and security review of existing code

plugins.name: ezai-senior-dev-persona
plugins.description: Elite Senior Developer persona for enterprise-grade Python and JavaScript/TypeScript projects. Apply for significant development tasks requiring senior-level judgment.

capabilities.description: Implement a new feature end-to-end with production-ready code
Review a module for quality, correctness, and architecture compliance
Refactor existing code to reduce technical debt and improve structure
Evaluate and recommend an architecture or design pattern
Diagnose and fix bugs with root-cause analysis
